oncall-bot: PagerDuty: INCIDENT PD12345 fired -> service=runtime-high-latency, priority=P1. Pager: primary on-call rotation.
alex chen: acked on PD and here. seeing alert: p95 latency spike for text-generation route. pulling dashboards.
maria gonzalez: on it — checking route-level pods and KV cache heat. no obvious deploys in last 30m.
 tj park: grabbing traces now. prelim: lots of 503s from one AZ, looks like short-lived overload on gpu-pool-3.
alex chen: ran quick prometheus query: rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[1m]) spikes. snippet:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="runtime"}[1m])) by (le))
```
maria gonzalez: fwiw KV cache hitrate didn't drop. might be transient queuing. scaling events? checking autoscaler logs.
oncall-bot: PD update: PD12345 status=triggered -> auto-resolve threshold=60s.
 alex chen: I'm going to cordon bad node if it looks persistent. trying `kubectl get pods -o wide` now.
 tj park: infra metrics show a brief GPU driver hiccup on host gpu-12 in us-west2-a — kernel messages show GPU reset. very short (20-40s).
maria gonzalez: I can drain and move traffic off gpu-12 if it stays flaky. patching a temporary affinity rule to avoid gpu-12.
 alex chen: ack. doing `kubectl drain gpu-12-node --ignore-daemonsets` (dry-run first).
oncall-bot: PD update: PD12345 auto-resolved after 37s — reason: metric returned below threshold. No ack escalation required.
 sre-rotation: quick note — customer-facing error rate didn't breach SLI thresholds; marginal p95 bump but no user-visible timeouts in synthetic checks.
alex chen: closing loop for now but leaving node cordon in progress until we confirm driver patch. will follow up in postmortem if it reappears.
maria gonzalez: thanks. creating quick incident note in #incidents and tagging infra. recommend adding a short-lived rule to suppress identical noise if it flaps in next 5m.
 tj park: +1. leaving watch for 10m. if it re-fires we escalate to oncall-sidekick and run driver repro steps.
alex chen: thx everyone. handing back to rotation. tagging @sre-rotation for next shift handoff
